period.measured: Amkor quarterly revenue YoY growth for Q2-2026 vs Q2-2025
period.rule: the claim names NO period anywhere — not in the metric, not in source_of_actual ('edgar:AMKR:Revenues'), and it is the only sealed claim with no operator note. The reading adopted is the quarter the CITED CONSENSUS describes, because the claim's relation to that consensus is `deviates_from`: a claim betting against a specific number must measure the period that number describes, or it is not testing the deviation at all.
period.rejected_reading: Q3-2026 (the last quarter reporting before as_of 2026-10-31) — plausible from as_of alone, but as_of 2026-10-31 is the generic window-[1] date run_job_a injects for every claim (DEBT X3, hardcoded resolution dates), so it carries no information about which quarter was intended.
evidence: CONFIRMED 2026-08-11 against SEC companyfacts: the wall's AMKR 0q revenue avg 1,810,942,010 with growth 0.1982 implies a year-ago quarter of 1,511,385,420; Amkor's filed standalone quarter 2025-04-01..2025-06-30 (us-gaap RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax) is 1,511,392,000. Ratio 0.9999955. The cited 0q consensus is therefore Q2-2026 vs Q2-2025.

AMKR had not reported Q2-2026 at seal time (sealed 2026-07-29; Amkor reports Q2 in early August), so under this reading the claim was still forward-looking when sealed — which is what pre-registration requires.
period.why_confirmation_required: This ruling infers INTENT from the cited_wall relation rather than reading it off the claim's words, because the claim has no words on the subject. That is a judgement about what a human meant, and a machine should not make it silently. resolve_preflight kept this claim BLOCKED until an operator set operator_confirmed — which happened 2026-08-12 (see operator_confirmation above). The flag stays `required: true` on purpose: it records that this reading needed a human, and a future edit to the period would need one again.

currency.basis: IMMUNE: the graded quantity is a YoY growth RATE — a ratio of two USD figures — so it is dimensionless. Amkor is a US filer reporting in USD and its wall entry is a US listing.

amendments.amends: limitations[0] — LOOK-BACK RISK (DEBT D7, which is OPEN)
amendments.text: the look-back limitation stands as a recorded fact about this claim (measured quarter reported days after seal); the guard class is closed (D7/V14).
amendments.why: The limitation's parenthetical said D7 was OPEN. That was true when it was written on 2026-08-11 and is false now: D7 closed 2026-08-12 in c9ddb0f (P-G49), which shipped the V14 look-back guard. A reader meeting the limitation at this claim's 2026-10-31 resolution would read the present tense and conclude the class is still unguarded.
amendments.what_this_does_NOT_change: the limitation itself is NOT waived, softened or rewritten. The measured quarter (ending 2026-06-30) really did report days after the 2026-07-29 seal, and that proximity publishes with the resolution exactly as recorded. Only the claim about the DEBT item's status is corrected. Note also that V14 is a DRAFT-time rule keyed off sealed_commit, so it could not and does not apply retroactively to this sealed claim — the guard prevents the next one, it does not re-grade this one.
amendments.append_only_note: limitations[0] is left byte-identical on purpose. A recorded ruling is amended by adding a dated entry beside it, never by editing the sentence a reader may already have seen (CLAUDE.md rule 2).

amendments.amends: limitations[0] (LOOK-BACK RISK), period.evidence[1], and the P-G51 amendment's 'really did report days after the 2026-07-29 seal' — all three say Q2-2026 was reported AFTER the seal. It was reported BEFORE.
amendments.text: CAVEAT — NOT A FORECAST AT SEAL TIME. Amkor published Q2-2026 results ~34.5 hours BEFORE this claim was created (2026-07-29T06:40:12Z): the earnings 8-K (Item 2.02, Ex. 99.1, accession 0001047127-26-000043) was accepted by EDGAR 2026-07-27T20:08:09Z, headlined 'Net sales $1.90 billion, up 26% year-on-year'; the 10-Q (0001047127-26-000046) followed 2026-07-28T19:36:50Z. The graded figure (1,897,965 / 1,511,392 USD thousands - 1 = 0.255773) was therefore PUBLIC when the claim was drafted. The claim grades as written, and that grade publishes — but it is a postdiction against a public number, not a forward test, and a reader must not count it as forecasting evidence in either direction.
amendments.why: The 2026-08-11 limitation assumed 'Amkor reports Q2 in early August' and the 2026-08-11 companyfacts probe saw no Q2 standalone fact; both were inferences, not a check of the filing record. EDGAR submissions (checked 2026-11-11, at resolution) show the 8-K and 10-Q acceptance timestamps above. Publishing the resolution with a limitation that says the opposite of the filing record would put a false statement under the verdict.
amendments.what_this_does_NOT_change: The period reading (Q2-2026, operator-confirmed P-G46) is NOT reopened: it follows from the `deviates_from` relation to the cited consensus, which is independent of when the quarter reported. The verdict is NOT waived or re-graded. limitations[0], period.evidence[1] and the P-G51 amendment are left byte-identical. Whether the drafting model had this figure in its context is NOT established here — only that it was public.
amendments.append_only_note: Appended beside the statements it corrects, per the P-G51 precedent (CLAUDE.md rule 2). Recorded BEFORE the actual was attested so the caveat rides into resolutions/<cid>_manual.json's grading_basis.amendments and the published resolution.
